text:
anna (PM): Heads up — ACME flagged they’ll go to CompetitorZ unless we offer per-tenant routing controls ASAP. They called it "tenant-level routing". Asking for scope and timeline.

mike (eng): We can ship a basic per-tenant route flag + API in ~2 sprints. Full policy engine (conditions, fallback tiers) is much larger.

sophia (research): Model-level routing adds KV cache fragmentation risk. If we limit to presets + explicit model pins per-tenant, latency hit is minimal.

kevin (sales): ACME: $400k ARR TCV. They want routing + visibility + per-tenant quotas. If we give a pilot with visibility and SLA, they can pause PoC with CompetitorZ.

jules (design): UX note: we should avoid copying their whole policy UI. Proposal: Routing Presets (3 presets) + an advanced JSON editor hidden in advanced settings. Keeps parity but feels our own.

mike (eng): Minimum dev list for v1: API endpoint, tenant preset table, model pinning, metrics tag, basic fallback rule (static). Estimate: 6–8 weeks if not blocked.

anna (PM): Proposal: break into two deliverables — (A) Routing Presets + API v1 (pilot for ACME) in 4 weeks; (B) Policy Engine + quotas in Q3. We need to confirm tradeoffs.

sophia (research): +1 to two-phase. Also add a small perf spike to measure cache fragmentation: 3 days. I can own.

rollout-bot: Deploy preview for feature/routing-presets posted: https://ci.internal/1234 — integration tests failing (2).

mike (eng): I'll triage tests today. Keep API backward-compatible; add feature flag for beta.

kevin (sales): If we can promise pilot visibility + SLA for 6 weeks, we can defer competitor objection and close the ACME pilot. Need exact wording for commit.

anna (PM): Decision: ship Routing Presets + API v1 as limited beta for ACME (target 4 weeks). Follow-up epic for Policy Engine & quotas. @mike please confirm timelines and open the spike ticket for perf.

mike (eng): Confirmed. Opening tickets now: spike for cache perf and epic for routing v1. Will tag owners and add acceptance criteria (API, telemetry, fallback).

jules (design): Will draft the preset UX and the pilot email copy for ACME.

kevin (sales): I'll draft the commitment language and loop legal on pilot SLA.

anna (PM): Thanks — keeping this tight. We'll sync weekly in product standup. :thumbsup:
